Required Documents for Schengen Tourist Visa (Category C)

Please submit the following original documents along with one set of copies:

1. Travel Document (Passport)

A valid passport issued within the last 10 years, with at least two blank visa pages. The passport must be valid for at least 3 months beyond the planned date of departure from the Schengen area.

2. Proof of Financial Means

Personal original bank account statements showing financial movements over the last 3 months, certified and stamped by the issuing bank. Online printouts without bank stamp are not accepted.

3. Travel Health Insurance

Mandatory travel health insurance certificate with minimum coverage of 30,000 EUR covering emergency medical evacuation and repatriation throughout the entire Schengen territory.

4. Employment Proof

For employed applicants: A formal no-objection certificate (NOC) and approved leave letter from the current employer on company letterhead, stating position, duration of leave, and salary. Salary slips for the last 3 months are required.

5. Proof of Accommodation and Travel

Confirmed hotel reservation or formal sponsorship declaration (Verpflichtungserklärung). Confirmed round-trip flight booking or itinerary.
